texts.zh: 在最近的电力风暴后，[this.GetName]上观察到了一种异常现象。该行星的[GetOceansState]现已充斥着永久性的电流，电流在广阔的水体中循环，对水生生物构成致命威胁。
texts.en: An unusual phenomenon has been observed on [this.GetName] in the wake of the recent Electric Storm. The planet's [GetOceansState] have been left charged with a perpetual electrical current now circulating in this vast body of water, posing lethal risks for aquatic life.

summary.text:
# 带电海洋 / Electrified Oceans

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · DLC: Cosmic Storms

## 如何开始 How it starts

电暴离开拥有潮湿或寒冷殖民地的星系时（00_on_actions.txt:5433），隐藏事件 cstorms.1710 有25%概率排程 cstorms.1715（90天后）。

When an electric storm leaves a system with a wet or cold colony (00_on_actions.txt:5433) hidden cstorms.1710 has a 25% chance of scheduling cstorms.1715 (after 90 days).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

cstorms.1715“带电海洋”：正文随物种是否水生而变。

cstorms.1715 "Electrified Oceans": text varies with an aquatic main species.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

选项a：获得能量收入（水生物种另得团结）；选项b：星球获得 d_electrified_oceans 矿点。两个选项互斥。

Option a: energy income (aquatic species also unity); option b: the planet gets the d_electrified_oceans deposit. The two are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

Cosmic Storms DLC；每国一次。

Cosmic Storms DLC; once per country.
